stories.title: BMC starts demolition of building linked to Dawood Ibrahim in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Thursday (November 19, 2026) began pulling down a dilapidated building in south Mumbai, which was once the residence and an early base of fugitive gangster and 1993 serial blasts mastermind Dawood Ibrahim, officials said. The razing of the Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana building on Pakmodia Street in the Bhendi Bazaar area proceeded peacefully under heavy police security, they said.

stories.title: Mumbai civic body razes 74 structures to ease traffic on Andheri-Kurla Road
stories.summary: 40-metre-wide Development Plan (DP) road in Andheri to ease traffic congestion on the Andheri-Kurla Road. The civic body began the demolition drive on Wednesday, and plans to clear a total of 138 structures over three days. The action is being carried out along the stretch between Hasanath School on Kadamwadi Road and Uttam Dhaba on Marol-Maroshi Road in the K-East Ward.

stories.title: IIT-Bombay alumnus takes charge as Western Railway's new spokesperson
stories.summary: After years of keeping trains running smoothly, Arun Kumar Meena now has a different task on his hands — ensuring Western Railway's message reaches millions of commuters. Meena, a 2014-batch Indian Railway Traffic Service (IRTS) officer, took charge as Western Railway's new Chief Public Relations Officer (CPRO) on Thursday, marking a shift from managing railway operations to handling the public communication of one of Mumbai's busiest suburban railway networks.

stories.title: Aamir Khan rents three flats for ₹38 lakh per month in Mumbai’s Santacruz
stories.summary: 65 crore over the next four years. The apartments, located in Seasons Trimurti on North Avenue Road, have a combined carpet area of 12,200 sq ft and come with nine car parking spaces. The actor’s move to rented accommodation is linked to the redevelopment of his existing residences at Bella Vista and Marina Apartments in Pali Hill.

stories.title: Maharashtra govt's announcement to rename Dadar railway station turns out to be a faux pas, CMO clarifies a day later that only Dadar Metro station will be renamed
stories.summary: The CMO pointed to the Director General of Information and Public Relations (DGIPR) for the error. Wednesday's DGIPR release was headlined: "Dadar railway station to be named Chaityabhoomi. The legislature will fulfil the necessary requirements during the session - CM Devendra Fadnavis." It also stated that the govt had sent a letter to the Centre conveying in-principle approval to the demand for renaming Dadar railway station.

stories.title: Six-lane Naringi creek bridge to cut Vasai-Virar-Palghar travel time by an hour
stories.summary: The Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA) on Wednesday approved the construction of a six-lane bridge across Naringi creek in Virar, a project expected to shorten the road journey between Vasai-Virar and Palghar by around 25 km and cut travel time by nearly an hour.

stories.title: Mumbai: Men seen queuing up to collect suspicious tablets under Bandra bridge
stories.summary: On my way to work, as I passed the northern end of the Bandra East foot overbridge, I noticed something unusual. A queue of men had gathered amidst heaps of garbage beneath the bridge. Several were standing with cash in their hands, apparently waiting for their turn. One man, holding a stick, appeared to be organising the queue.

stories.title: FDA suspends licences of Chaayos, 5 Spice, Blinkit in Mumbai
stories.summary: 23 crore, suspending 23 food business licences and ordering eight unregistered vendors in Pune to shut down. stories.title: Mumbai: Bombay High Court puts Prabhadevi residents’ demolition on hold, families await relief
stories.summary: With tears in their eyes and uncertainty hanging over their future, hundreds of families living near the south end of Prabhadevi railway station spent Thursday anxiously waiting to find out whether they would still have homes in the coming days. November 19 was the date they feared losing their homes, belongings and a neighbourhood they have lived in for decades.

stories.title: Four, including seven-year-old girl, injured in Mira Road chawl fire
stories.summary: Four people, including a seven-year-old girl, suffered burn injuries after a fire broke out in their home in a chawl in the Janata Nagar area of Kashimira in Mira Road East on Thursday. The fire department’s preliminary assessment suggests that a leak from a domestic LPG cylinder caused gas to accumulate inside the house, which ignited when someone switched on a light.

stories.title: Mumbai: GRP assures action after Mid-day flags suspected tablet distribution under Bandra bridge

stories.title: Mumbai civic body pushes to fast-track two 2,000 MLD water projects at Bhandup
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has directed officials and contractors to complete its new water treatment plant and pumping station at the Bhandup Complex ahead of their scheduled deadlines, stressing the need to accelerate construction and ensure coordination between departments. Additional Municipal Commissioner (Projects) Abhijit Bangar issued the directions during an inspection of the project sites on Thursday.

stories.title: Mumbai: Andheri residents oppose tree felling at Nana Nani Park
stories.summary: Verosva and Andheri residents gathered on Thursday morning for the second consecutive day of protests after nearly 40 trees were felled at Nana Nani Park near Seven Bungalows. The protesters assembled around 11 am and stayed until noon, staging a silent demonstration with banners and forming a human chain.

stories.title: Mumbai: Tears and uncertainty as hundreds of Prabhadevi families face eviction
stories.summary: With tears in their eyes and uncertainty hanging over their future, hundreds of families living near the south end of Prabhadevi railway station spent Thursday anxiously waiting to find out whether they would still have homes in the coming days. November 19 was the date they feared losing their homes, belongings and a neighbourhood they have lived in for decades.

stories.title: Mumbai: MLA steps in after Mid-day report on dumping near Lokhandwala Lake
stories.summary: Taking serious note of mid-day’s report on alleged debris dumping near Lokhandwala Lake , Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Haroon Khan visited the site on Wednesday and assured members of the Lokhandwala Oshiwara Citizens Association (LOCA) that he would take up the matter with the Mangrove Cell and other concerned authorities.

stories.title: Saif Ali Khan gets death threat from accused in Baba Siddiqui's murder case: Report
stories.summary: After the gunfire incident on Tiger Shroff, Bollywood has been facing a series of death threats. Several celebrity names have surfaced and now as per a latest update Saif Ali Khan has got a death threat with the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, a wanted accused in the Baba Siddiqui murder case, emerging in connection with the threat.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC Launches Demolition Drive At Dilapidated Musafirkhana Building | Videos
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) launched a demolition drive at the dilapidated Musafirkhana building in Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar. Heavy police deployment was seen at the site as civic authorities carried out the operation. The action comes amid concerns over the condition of the ageing structure. Visuals from the area show a strong security presence as the demolition drive gets underway.

stories.title: Mumbai housing societies to get 15% property tax rebate for efficient waste management
stories.summary: The BMC has announced a property tax incentive of up to 15% for residential housing societies that comply with prescribed waste management norms, including processing wet waste on their premises, managing dry waste and adopting water conservation measures. The incentives form part of a wider push by the BMC to enforce four-way waste segregation across Mumbai (wet, dry, sanitary and special care or environmentally harmful waste).

stories.title: Mumbai: Nearly 9,500 Of 10,447 Fire Hydrants Allegedly Non-Functional; BJP Corporator Nitesh Singh Seeks
stories.summary: BJP corporator Nitesh Singh has urged the BMC to audit Mumbai's fire hydrant network and restore defunct facilities to strengthen emergency firefighting preparedness | X - @niteshsingh_bjp Mumbai, November 19, 2026: With nearly 9,500 of Mumbai’s 10,447 fire hydrants allegedly non-functional, shut or buried under roads and footpaths, the city’s firefighting infrastructure has come under scrutiny following 499 fire incidents reported during the five days of Diwali.

stories.title: Mumbai Coastal Road BMW Crash: Police Suspect 4 Occupants Had Consumed Alcohol; FSL Reports Awaited After 2
stories.summary: According to police sources, there is a suspicion that BMW driver Shanay Gajjar (21) and the three other occupants had consumed alcohol before the accident. It is learnt that the four had attended a party at Gajjar’s residence on Peddar Road and were travelling towards the Coastal Road after the party when the accident occurred.

stories.title: Mumbai woman constable bursts firecrackers inside Andheri police station to celebrate senior inspector's transfer, claims she will get 6 more officers shifted
stories.summary: A woman constable attached to Andheri police station allegedly burst firecrackers on the station premises on Tuesday to celebrate the transfer of senior inspector Umesh Machindar to Mumbai Police's Special Branch-I. The constable had allegedly threatened Machindar with further action and claimed she would get six more police officers transferred from Andheri police station.

stories.title: CR puts the brakes on housekeeping takeover of 14 Navi Mumbai stations
stories.summary: Central Railway’s (CR) plan to take over housekeeping at 14 Navi Mumbai railway stations has run into a legal roadblock, with the administration telling the City and Industrial Development Corporation of Maharashtra (CIDCO) to settle the dispute involving 267 contractual sanitation workers before proceeding further.

stories.title: BMC to install voice-enabled CCTV cameras across Mumbai to tackle littering
stories.summary: After Mahim in G North Ward, more parts of Mumbai are set to get AI-enabled, voice-alert CCTV cameras to curb littering . The city currently has 136 Garbage Vulnerable Points (GVPs) under regular CCTV surveillance. These cameras will gradually be replaced with voice-enabled ones wherever ward officials see the need.

stories.title: Mumbai: Somaiya University teaches students wildlife conservation
stories.summary: Somaiya Vidyavihar University has set up life-sized photographs of wildlife across its 50-acre campus in Vidyavihar , giving students an immersive experience of spotting birds and animals in their natural surroundings. The initiative, titled ‘Coexistence’, is part of the university’s academic programme and aims to spread the message: “Save wildlife today, or see them only in frames tomorrow.”

stories.title: Mumbai Weather Update: Sunny Skies, Cold Winds Bring Relief As Morning Temperature Drops To 25°C; AQI Remains Poor
stories.summary: Mumbai woke up to sunny skies and cold winds on Friday, with the morning temperature hovering around 25°C, offering some respite from the warm and humid conditions of recent weeks. However, the relatively cooler start did little to ease concerns over air pollution, as haze and smog continued to linger across several parts of the city.

stories.title: Gangster linked to Dawood's D-Company shot dead in UP: Police
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (STF), in a joint operation with the Delhi Crime Branch, shot dead a wanted gangster carrying a reward of ₹ 50,000 in an encounter in Bulandshahr's Sikandrabad police station area, police officials said on Friday. The deceased, identified as Naseem Durrani, a Ghaziabad resident, was wanted in two murder cases in Delhi and allegedly had links with underworld don Dawood Ibrahim's D-Company.

stories.title: 47 Trains Cancelled, Over 3 Lakh Evacuated As Cyclone Akvan Heads To Odisha
stories.summary: Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan is likely to cross the North Andhra Pradesh , Yanam and South Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to Gopalpur, by noon on Friday (November 20, 2026), the IMD said. stories.title: Removal proceedings against me infructuous after resignation: Justice Varma tells Lok Sabha Secretariat
stories.summary: Justice Yashwant Varma has contended that proceedings for his removal as a high court judge became infructuous following his resignation and cannot be continued, saying any attempt to remove him from office would be without constitutional foundation. In a letter dated September 10 to Lok Sabha Secretary General Utpal Kumar Singh, he responded to the report of the inquiry committee constituted by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla.

stories.title: Kashmir Free From "India-Born Terrorists" After 35 Years: Amit Shah After Lateef Bhat's Killing
stories.summary: A day after security forces killed Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorist Lateef Bhat in Kulgam, Union home minister Amit Shah said Kashmir was free of India-born terrorists for the first time in 35 years, terming it a “significant milestone”.

stories.summary: Being compared to his father, Shah Rukh Khan , was perhaps inevitable for Aryan Khan . stories.title: Hello, Earth! Nasa's Voyager 1 phones home from beyond 16 billion miles
stories.summary: Nasa's Voyager 1 has phoned home from a staggering one light-day away, with a radio signal from the spacecraft taking exactly 24 hours to reach Earth. Voyager 1 crossed the one-light-day distance threshold on Wednesday at 5:16 am EST (10:16 GMT), Nasa said. stories.title: Uttarakhand Bank Manager, 2 Agents Arrested In Rs 9 Lakh Bribery Case
stories.summary: Dehradun, A Bank of Baroda branch manager and two intermediaries here have been arrested for demanding a cut for sanctioning a loan to an applicant, the Central Bureau of Investigation said on Thursday. The CBI registered an instant case on November 18 against the manager of the bank's Indira Nagar branch in Dehradun and two private persons working as Direct Selling Agents , based on a complaint.

stories.title: Kerala CBI court convicts 13 in 2012 MSF activist murder, acquits CPI(M) leaders Jayarajan, Rajesh
stories.summary: A special Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) court in Ernakulam on Thursday convicted 13 CPI(M) activists in the 2012 murder of Muslim Students Federation (MSF) activist Ariyil Abdul Shukoor, sentencing seven of them to life imprisonment, while acquitting 18 others, including senior party leaders P Jayarajan and TV Rajesh, of conspiracy charges.

stories.title: ‘I waived tax on ₹12 lakh income bracket. Did you hike salaries?’ PM Modi asks industries
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday heaped praise on the government's income tax relief to the corporate sector but also asked industries if they increased salaries or hired more employees. At the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI)'s centenary convention, PM Modi urged India Inc or the corporate sector to ensure that the benefits of tax cuts also reached employees.

stories.title: Devotees visiting Guruvayur temple must be treated with respect, says Kerala High Court
stories.summary: The Kerala High Court has held that every devotee visiting the Guruvayur Sree Krishna Temple ought to be cared for and treated with respect. Temple employees at every level must act with the highest degree of equanimity and must not lose their temper with any devotee.

stories.title: PM Modi To Inaugurate First-Ever SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum At Delhi's Historic Purana Qila Today To Celebrate Shared Heritage
stories.summary: New Delhi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum at Purana Qila in New Delhi on Friday, an initiative aimed at celebrating the region's shared civilisational heritage, strengthening people-to-people ties and promoting cross-cultural dialogue and cooperation.

stories.title: MP Board Exam Confusion Hits 20 Lakh Students As Half-Yearly Tests Follow Old Pattern Despite New Annual Exam Format
stories.summary: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): Even as the Madhya Pradesh School Education Department claims to have introduced a new examination pattern for Classes 9 to 12, it has begun half-yearly exams in the old format, leaving nearly 20 lakh students caught between two assessment systems.

stories.title: AQI worsens, city sees lowest temp of season | Latest News Delhi
stories.summary: Air quality in the Capital deteriorated on Thursday, with the city’s average Air Quality Index (AQI) rising 48 points to 280 from 232 a day earlier, as unfavourable meteorological conditions slowed the dispersal of pollutants. The AQI remained in the “poor” category on Thursday, with forecasts indicating further deterioration from Friday.

stories.title: US prosecutor declines charges against white cop who killed Black man
stories.summary: Dane County district attorney Ismael Ozanne said officer Kiel Baitinger-Peterson acted reasonably when he shot Corey Ruiz on July 22. Ozanne said the circumstances left the officer with no reasonable alternative and that there was no potential criminal liability. He said his decision followed a review of police reports, diagrams, surveillance footage, squad car videos and recordings made by members of the public.

stories.title: Women in high public office doesn’t mean equality throughout society: Justice Nagarathna
stories.summary: V. Nagarathna, one of the senior most judges of the Supreme Court and in line to be the first woman Chief Justice of India, has said that the mere existence of women in high public office does not establish that equality has been achieved throughout society.

stories.title: IAF’s ‘active Rafale count cut to 32’ by FlightGlobal; Defence Ministry disputes claim

stories.title: Fiona, Global Sensation Hippo, Dies After Eating Visitor's Hat At US Zoo

stories.title: Senate rejects resolution to block Trump from striking Iran
stories.summary: Senate Republicans have blocked another effort to limit President Donald Trump’s military actions in Iran , voting against a resolution that would have directed him to end the conflict. He claimed that the entire Australian team knew about the incident and that only three players were punished.

stories.summary: US envoy Jared Kushner has said Donald Trump is open to extending Ukraine a security guarantee similar to Nato’s mutual defence clause , but stressed that Washington has to protect its interests too.
